description: Rules for the task-execution framework. This file is control plane: agents cannot change it. The engine (harness/orchestration/engine.cjs) reads it; tests and validate-orchestration check that the two agree.
limitsNote: Placeholder working values chosen by this design, not derived from any external requirement. The owner may change them.

transitionNotes.RUNNING>AWAITING_APPROVAL: the work needs a human decision part-way; the attempt is refunded because nothing was completed
transitionNotes.RUNNING>READY: only by release, when an attempt never ran (for example the tool rejected a malformed call after the hook started it); the attempt is refunded and the release is logged with its reason
transitionNotes.COMPLETED>VALIDATING: only by resume, when a recorded artifact no longer matches its hash
transitionNotes.COMPLETED>READY: only by reopen, after a blocking review verdict, within maxReopensPerTask
transitionNotes.FAILED>READY: only by retry, when the error class is retryable and attempts remain
transitionNotes.READY>PENDING: only by the reopen cascade, which invalidates dependents of a reopened task
transitionNotes.VALIDATING>BLOCKED: a missing input discovered while validating

TRANSIENT.meaning: Timeout, rate limit, network or tool crash that may not recur

INTERRUPTED.meaning: The attempt stopped without reporting (crash, closed session, expired lease)

ACCEPTANCE_FAILED.meaning: The output was produced but failed an acceptance test. The retry must use a changed prompt that carries the failed checks

INPUT_MISSING.meaning: A needed input, context file or answer is absent. Another attempt cannot fix it

PERMISSION_DENIED.meaning: A guard or hook refused an action. Trying another route is a bypass, not a retry

CONFLICT.meaning: Requirements, constraints or agent outputs contradict each other and need a human decision

POLICY_VIOLATION.meaning: A hard constraint or approval rule was broken or nearly broken. The run is frozen for human review

INTERNAL.meaning: The framework's own state is inconsistent or corrupt

UNKNOWN.meaning: Not recognised. One retry, then escalate

ENOENT|no such file|file not found|missing (input|context|requirement)|cannot find .*context|decision .* (is )?open

commandNote: A command check is an argv that must match one pattern here. It is run without a shell, after the repository command guard, and only by `tasks.mjs validate`, never by a hook. A plan cannot add commands: this list is the only source.

approval.note: A task approval is a human decision on a task, signed with the same registered approver keys as operation approvals (harness/policy/approvers.json). It is bound to the plan hash, run and task. It is separate from operation approvals, which the permission hooks check on each tool call.
